clues: This city lies in eastern Gansu province, China. It touches Shaanxi province to the south and east, and Ningxia to the north.
High land shapes the weather in this city. Winters are cold and dry, summers are warm and wet, and most rain falls from June to September.
This town was first built in the year 376. That start was more than one thousand six hundred years ago.
Old records say the Ashina clan came from this city. That clan founded the First Turkic Khaganate, a vast realm of its age.
Near this city stand the Kongtong Mountains, held sacred in Taoism. Tales say the Yellow Emperor met an immortal on their peaks.
